newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mafatlal Sec recommends ICICI Bank's IPO.
newsitem.headline: India Mafatlal Sec recommends ICICI Bank's IPO.

text.p: Mafatlal Securities Ltd said on Monday it recommended investment in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares by ICICI Banking Corporation Ltd (ICICI Bank).

"ICICI Bank follows a relatively conservative approach like HDFC Bank by maintaining a reasonable balance between speedy growth and cautious lending," analyst Prasanna Marar siad in a report. The IPO opens on August 5.
"The share at 35 rupees is being offered at 13 X FY97 earnings and 10.6 X FY98 projected earnings while HDFC Bank is traded at 36 X FY97 earnings and 21 X FY98 projected earnings."
Mafatlal Securities said public sector banks such as State Bank of India, Bank of Baroda and Bank of India are traded at 12-13 X FY97 earnings.
"Considering that ICICI Bank is similar in many ways to HDFC Bank we fell that the offer price of 35 rupees offers good scope for appreciation," the report said.
It said it recommended investment in ICICI Bank's IPO for good gains in the medium term.
The issue is aimed at raising 1.44 billion rupees.
ICICI Bank's equity capital after the issue would be at 1.65 billion rupees, the report said.
ICICI Bank is a subsidiary of Industrial Credit and Investment Corpo of India Ltd, India's second largest long-term lending bank.
